svg.title: C48 | Conceptual ERD — business concepts
svg.desc: Proposed C48 design. Aligned shapes and orthogonal connectors. Editable diagrams.net source accompanies this SVG.
svg.text: 1 = exactly one 0..1 = optional one 0..* = zero or many 1..* = one or many
Reporter and Donor are participant roles; the Affected household is a request-scoped snapshot, never an account. A Donor needs no account; a Campaign and an SOS are independent.

Item lines (drive items, donation lines, relief needs, distribution lines) reference Item; roles, grants, audit and notices are cross-cutting. Cross-service links are opaque IDs. Proposed design, not implemented.
